verdict.rationale: Portkey's virtual keys and Model Catalog let you add a provider whose credentials are "stored securely, never exposed in code". You then route traffic to it with one Portkey API key and `@provider-slug/model-name`, which is the BYOK pattern for gateway traffic. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the key-entry workflow (e.g., pasting your own OpenAI/Anthropic key, rotation, per-request key passthrough), plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
